title: Lacatski says the reverse engineering was semi-successful

tellings.quote: our own programs that have been successful to some extent per James Latsky saying yeah we were semisuccessful

plain: US efforts at reverse engineering, taking apart recovered non-human craft to learn how they work, were "semisuccessful," according to James Lacatski, a defense intelligence scientist who ran a Pentagon-funded UFO study. Dylan Borland, a former Air Force intelligence man, tells Michels this second-hand, saying Lacatski himself admitted the US programs had succeeded "to some extent"; if true, it would mean the US has drawn some working knowledge from such craft.
